capabilities: Generate a new node from nearby nodes via the OpenAI API
Connect the generated node to the selected node with an outgoing edge
Configure the OpenAI API key in settings
extras: README states it is in Alpha, only works on text nodes, and lists basic setup steps; it warns a user-provided OpenAI API key or local service is required. A TODO list includes error handling and support for non-text nodes.
problem: Obsidian Canvas has no built-in way to have an LLM generate and attach new nodes to an existing canvas graph.

relations.evidence: Let the OpenAI LLM add nodes to your canvas.

summary: AI canvas helper that generates a new text node connected by an edge, using the OpenAI API and nearby nodes as context.
